# Brief: Three Coins

A one-screen 2D platformer for the Kiln end-to-end smoke run.

- The player runs and jumps (Celeste-like feel numbers from the pipeline skill).
- Three coins float over platforms; touching one collects it with a sound.
- Collecting all three shows a win screen with "Again".
- Title screen → game → pause → win → again.
- Pixel art at 320×180, 16 px tiles, one palette of 16 colours.
